grades.certifications: Flammability (UL 94) V0 (p. 1, as printed; a typical value, not a certificate: verify grade, thickness and certificate)
grades.rationale: Documented commercial formulation; traceable manufacturer evidence Filed under TPV on 2026-09-28 (m223-what-the-makers-say-it-is), moved from TPE, polymer not stated: thermoplastic vulcanizate, "TPV is a high-quality thermoplas+c vulcanizate" (R-FABRU-10255-Material-data-sheet-TPV-98A-purefil, p. 1). Its own sheet names its class, a thermoplastic vulcanizate (ISO 18064 TPV), as purefil's TPS 40D sheet names a styrenic block copolymer: a material of its own, TPV, as TPS is (R196). The text layer draws the "ti" ligature as "+". Read by an AI agent (claude-opus-5.5), not a person.
